newsitem.title: UK: London tea auction finds good demand.
newsitem.headline: London tea auction finds good demand.

text.p: Strong and active demand was seen at the latest London Tea Auction, the Tea Brokers' Association of London reported.
Among landed teas, bright Kenyas and Burundis advanced 5 to 10 pence sterling and coloury mediums were also 3 to 6 pence higher. But plain Central Africans were easier. Ceylons were firm to dearer.
Among offshores, coloury Central Africans were mainly dearer but plain teas were neglected.
